evidence: For actor-only BB-vs-open states where the source folds, the 50th-74th preflop-percentile band had positive sampled-call value in three independent randomized Slumbot corpora. Target-call means were +0.79, +7.43, and +0.89 BB versus the deterministic fold value of -1 BB; target-call support was 17, 7, and 27 hands respectively.

bb_vs_open.reason: Defend the sampled profitable lower-middle BB band by calling instead of folding.
